title: The 3D object sizes do not update in another scene after saving the object's scene
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.dev2.official [7864ac801]

### System information

linux

### Issue description

In version v4.6.dev2.official, I noticed strange behavior where models, after being updated in their own scene, do not update in other scenes. At first, I thought this wouldn’t be a big deal, but today I finished a model that was initially 16 times larger. So I just changed the transform to 0.8 to make it game-ready, but then the second time I encountered a bug where the object in another scene doesn’t update its size – the only workaround is deleting and re-adding the object or manually resetting some parameters. The model is a standard Blender .glb.

### Steps to reproduce

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0798336f-f41f-4f05-a4b3-06f065b65ed5

The video first shows a scene where the old model is displayed 16 times larger because it used to be that size and all its parameters were taken from the old scene. But in reality, the new model has already been saved in the scene, and there shouldn’t be any trace of such sizes or anything similar. Of course, Godot hints in the parameters that the sizes are not original, but I don’t understand why it didn’t reset them automatically.

Maybe I didn’t notice before, but it used to seem that if you changed a model, saved the scene, everything would update in another scene. But for some reason, in this version, I’ve encountered this strange behavior for the second time. If this is normal behavior, correct me, but again, I don’t recall ever seeing this in any previous version.
